statement: For each ofL^2 port pairs put adjacent sites at(x,y,0),(x,y,1) with state(B,M) in{empty,0,1}x{0,1}. Match only certifiably clean emissions to their presented inputs: a clean empty capture after clearing, correct capture/read coins, no intervening fault and delay<=zeta. Every other emitted record is bad; failed/deleted/late inputs are bad under the stated horizon rule. Matching is causal, injective and order preserving; origins/event indices are mathematical annotations, never runtime counters. This is the complete issued unit-separated-port device, not a growing-distance channel.
